versions.changelog:
- Added clawhub.json for integration or configuration.
- No changes to functionality or documentation.
- Version bump to 1.1.0.

- Initial release of daily-worldcup2026 skill.
- Automatically generates daily FIFA World Cup 2026 content and TikTok scripts using free news sources.
- Supports news from qualifying matches, team news, host cities, venue updates, and tournament developments within the past 24 hours.
- Provides customizable TikTok script templates (60-90 seconds) with viral hashtag suggestions and region/topic focus.
- Integrates with multiple free sports news RSS feeds for up-to-date content.
- Includes guides on source setup, TikTok best practices, and World Cup 2026 timeline.
